strings.level.1.desc: You're set up. Now find someone to have a coffee with.
strings.level.2.desc: A few breaks in. This is how it starts.
strings.level.3.desc: You turn up for breaks, and people turn up for yours.
strings.level.4.desc: Your friends could order for you by now.
strings.level.5.desc: You've carried a lot of cups back to a lot of desks.
strings.level.6.desc: Plenty of breaks wouldn't have happened without you.
strings.level.7.desc: Most days, you're the reason the kettle goes on.
strings.level.8.desc: Top level. There's nothing after this, so enjoy the coffee.

strings.xp.how.title: How XP works
strings.xp.how.1: A friend joins Clink through you · +50

strings.xp.how.5: You bring a drink back for a friend · +20

strings.perm.cam.body: Clink needs the camera for drink snaps. They go to your friends only and come off their widgets after 24 hours.

strings.perm.contacts.body: Clink sends the numbers in your contacts to our server, encrypted, to check who's on Clink. They're used for that check and not kept.

strings.NSCameraUsageDescription: Clink uses the camera for drink snaps you share with friends.
strings.NSContactsUsageDescription: Clink checks your contacts to find friends who are already on Clink. Your contacts aren't stored.
strings.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Clink uses your library only when you pick a profile photo.

strings.perm.notif.body: A flare only works if people see it in time. You'll hear when a friend wants a drink and when someone joins yours. Snaps stay quiet.
